discovery: The installed sgl_kernel wheel already exports a native MUSA verify_tree_greedy op. It accepts arbitrary tree links with int64 tensors and does not need a new kernel. The 0.5.18 SGLang eagle_utils.py simply never called it for MUSA topk != 1.
integration: AIBOOK_NGRAM native path calls sgl_kernel.verify_tree_greedy with candidates/retrieve/target kinds converted to int64; CPU and torch-tree paths remain behind env flags for comparison.

160_64k.note: FP16 KV + NGRAM verify workspace exceeds budget

conclusion: Native MUSA tree verify works. 96/32K now reaches accept len 7 and 32.8 tok/s steady with 8.8GB free, satisfying the feasible-config goal. 128/64K and 160/64K still fail the >6GB constraint because NGRAM verify cannot use INT8 KV. Free-form ops prompts still accept ~1 draft and are slower than baseline.
